seeds.angle: Shared-apartment remote work and evening gaming: closed-back headset versus open-back headphones plus a separate microphone, balancing leakage, isolation, microphone routing, comfort, and repairability
seeds.intent: I work from a shared apartment during the day and game at the same desk at night. I am deciding between a closed-back headset and open-back headphones with a separate microphone, but I do not want to assume that one form factor is universally better. I need to understand sound leakage versus isolation, what the microphone and connection chain changes for calls and games, which comfort and serviceability claims can be checked before purchase, and what needs a real desk trial. Compare evidence-bounded configurations and finish with a conditional test-and-return decision rather than a universal winner.
